BASIC Information.Supported Apps/ Software: HeyMelody app: Customize your earbuds’ settings, update firmware, and more through the HeyMelody app.

Basic Information.Special Feature: Touch controls: Easily control playback, volume, and other functions with intuitive touch gestures.
Basic Information.Feature: LHDC 5.0: Oneplus Buds pro 3 Support for the LHDC 5.0 codec allows for high-quality wireless audio transmission.
Basic Information.Battery: Long-lasting battery: Enjoy up to 43 hours of total playtime with the charging case, providing ample listening time.
Basic Information.Others: Dual DACs: Each driver has its own dedicated DAC (Digital-to-Analog Converter), ensuring optimal audio performance and reduced crosstalk.
Basic Information.Charging Time: Fast charging: A quick charge of 10 minutes can provide up to 5 hours of playback.

Earbuds Feature.Microphone: Dual microphones: Two microphones per earbud help to capture and reduce background noise, ensuring clear calls.
Earbuds Feature.Water Resistance: IP55 rating: The earbuds are dust and water resistant, making them suitable for various environments.
Earbuds Feature.Drivers: Dual Drivers: Oneplus buds pro 3 feature dual drivers, including an 11mm woofer and a 6mm tweeter, for a balanced sound profile with rich bass, clear mids, and crisp highs.

Connectivity.Connectivity: Multipoint connectivity: Connect to two devices simultaneously for seamless switching between your phone and laptop.

Audio Features.Audio: Spatial Audio: Immerse yourself in a three-dimensional soundstage with spatial audio, providing a more immersive listening experience.
